description: Defines constants, enums, structs, and formatting for PDCP Protocol Data Units (PDUs) in a 3GPP telecommunications context, including size limits, header parsing, and formatting functions.

classes.name: pdcp_data_pdu_header
classes.description: Represents the header of a PDCP Data PDU, containing a sequence number.

classes.name: pdcp_control_pdu_header
classes.description: Represents the header of a PDCP Control PDU, containing the control PDU type.

methods.name: pdcp_pdu_get_dc
methods.description: Reads the Data/Control (D/C) field from the first byte of a PDCP PDU.

methods.name: pdcp_control_pdu_get_cpt
methods.description: Reads the Control PDU Type (CPT) from the first byte of a PDCP control PDU.
